system.name: GraphArena
system.one_liner: A benchmark testing LLMs on ten graph computation problems (four polynomial-time, six NP-complete) over real-world graphs, with graded scoring.

content.variant_note: three tinted bands: task cards sorted by complexity class, a prompt-to-verdict pipeline traced on one instance, and a reasoning quadrant
content.argues: GraphArena covers ten graph problems, four polynomial-time and six NP-complete, on real-world graphs, and grades each answer as correct, suboptimal or hallucinatory, not just by its final number.
content.subject: ten graph-problem cards, four graph data sources, one prompt with three graded LLM answers, a P/NP by graph-size quadrant

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a benchmark's scope as a grid of identical dashed cards, one tiny toy instance per task with its answer coloured, sorted into tinted bands by problem class; then trace a single instance through prompt, several model answers and traffic-light verdicts.
lessons.suits: Benchmarks or task suites whose tasks each fit a small toy instance and whose answers are graded on more than right or wrong.

summary: GraphArena is a benchmark that tests LLMs on real-world graph computation. Figure 1 is a three-band overview. A green band shows four polynomial-time tasks (Common Neighbor, Shortest Distance, Connected Component, Graph Diameter) ordered from local to global. A blue band around the GraphArena title shows six NP-complete tasks and the logos of four graph sources (OpenFlights, DBpedia, DBLP, PubChem). Each task is a dashed card with a toy node-link graph whose answer is coloured green. A salmon band follows one Maximum Clique instance through Problem Generation (a prompt), LLM Inference (three model answers) and a Scorer that stamps Correct, Suboptimal or Hallucinatory, and ends with a two-by-two quadrant of reasoning strategies (P versus NP, small versus large graphs). Drawn as flat vector with rounded Comic-Sans-style labels.
summary_zh: GraphArena 是评测大模型图计算能力的基准。图分三条色带：绿色为四个多项式时间任务，蓝色为六个 NP 完全任务和四个真实图数据源标志，橙色带用一个最大团实例串起提示生成、模型推理与三级评分，并给出 P/NP 与图规模的推理象限。
notes: Prior labels ranked contribution-mosaic first; reordered to scope-overview because the figure maps the task space (cards by complexity class) and only the lower band is a process. Prior subfield2 science-engineering changed to ml-core (graph problems posed to LLMs, no science application). The fourth verdict level (missing) appears in the text but not in the figure. Graph Edit Distance and the other NP cards are grouped into one element; Maximum Clique is separate because it is the one linked to the pipeline.
